issues.competing_evidence: Wu+02 abstract q=M2/M1=0.19±0.04; Bruch+19 quotes uncertain M1=1.24/M2=0.23 M_sun. Suleimanov+24 derives q=0.24–0.29 and M1=0.62–1.0 from disk precession/donor sequence. Wu full text inaccessible.
issues.why_it_matters: Mass/q affect population and evolutionary comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Retrieve Wu+02 full paper and reconcile its mass/q derivation and convention with Suleimanov+24; retain alternatives until then.
issues.public_status: Awaiting access to the original source

issues.competing_evidence: Gaensicke+99 author abstract and later papers report low-state WD Teff≈39000 K/M3.5 secondary; original fit tables/full text unavailable.
issues.why_it_matters: Atmosphere/template estimates could be mistaken for direct component measurements.
issues.needed_action: Obtain Gänsicke+99 full paper; transcribe atmosphere grid, errors, mass/gravity assumptions, donor decomposition and distance branch. Keep approximate low-state values meanwhile.
issues.public_status: Awaiting access to the original source

issues.competing_evidence: Wu+02 day period converts to 3.3012096 h but Bruch prints 3.3012086 h. Bruch abstract gives 8.90 h, conclusion 8.93 h for low-state oscillation. Superhumps are disk signals; earlier IP interpretation rejected.
issues.why_it_matters: Mislabeling a photometric modulation as WD spin/beat biases synchronization and evolutionary comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Check Wu+02 original period and Bruch+19 source data/table; retain both published forms, assign no spin interpretation without verification.

issues.competing_evidence: Coppejans+15 `2.3 reports Cordova et al. (1983) VLA <0.44 mJy at 4885 MHz/50 MHz during low state; original paper not accessed.
issues.why_it_matters: Historical state-dependent limit informs radio variability comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Locate Cordova et al. (1983) original paper and verify epoch, limit convention and state; leave labeled secondary-reported meanwhile.

issues.competing_evidence: Exact row has power-law flux, Gam1=1.664, Pow=2 and HasSpec=0; ReadMe defines Pow=2 as fitted spectrum but HasSpec indicates no custom-built spectrum.
issues.why_it_matters: Assumed spectrum/absorption affect flux and comparison with Ridder ASCA conversion.
issues.needed_action: Inspect Evans+20/Swift record for flags; document spectrum provenance before preferring 2SXPS flux. Keep both outputs model-dependent.

issues.competing_evidence: Coppejans+15 measures highly CP flare; gyrosynchrotron and ECME considered. B<100 G applies only to a large gyrosynchrotron region, not WD surface.
issues.why_it_matters: Using radio CP/region field as WD magnetism could change class and population interpretation.
issues.needed_action: Keep non-magnetic CV classification and no WD surface field. Require mechanism-specific evidence/component labels before radio-region field is used in cross-population comparisons.

references.short_citation: Swift 2SXPS exact TT Ari catalogue query
references.note: Exact query returns 2SXPS ID 78027. Mean 0.3–10 keV count-rate/flux; power-law flux products; NHg is Galactic line-of-sight estimate. Gam1=1.664, Pow=2, HasSpec=0; flag provenance queued.
references.full_citation: Evans, P. A., Page, K. L., Osborne, J. P., et al. 2020, “The Swift X-Ray Telescope Point Source Catalogue (2SXPS),” ApJS, 247, 54.

references.note: Local text and arXiv record inspected. HST/STIS low-state polar survey. ST LMi: first unambiguous WD-temperature measurement, Twd=10800 K for preferred two-temperature/cold-photosphere model, older estimates 12000-30000 K discussed, Porb=113.9 min tabulated, and distance 115 +/-21 pc. VV Pup: Twd=11900 K and older ~9000 K blackbody estimate superseded; Porb=100.4 min and B=31/56 MG tabulated. MR Ser: Twd=14200 K from FUV WD signature; discusses older MukaiCharles+86 Twd~9000/d=142 pc, Schwope+93 Twd=8500-10000 and M5-M6 donor/d=139 +/-13 pc, and argues FUV-based Twd is more accurate. TT Ari Table 7 lists Porb=198.0 min and WD temperature 39000 K, with reference 15 identified as Gaensicke et al. (1999).
